templates.wrongTense: You answered as if it were {selectedTenseLabel}, but {verb} in {tenseLabel} is '{correctAnswer}', not '{selectedAnswer}'.
templates.wrongSubject: You answered as if the subject were {selectedSubjectLabel}, but for {subjectLabel} of {verb} it's '{correctAnswer}', not '{selectedAnswer}'.
templates.wrongTenseAndSubject: You answered as if it were {selectedSubjectLabel} in {selectedTenseLabel}, but for {subjectLabel} in {tenseLabel}, {verb} is '{correctAnswer}', not '{selectedAnswer}'.

tenseNotes.preterite: Completely irregular stem: fui, foste, foi, fomos, foram. Completed past -- a state or event that happened once and is over.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Irregular stem: era, eras, era, éramos, eram, eram. Imperfect past -- an ongoing or habitual state ('used to be').

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: estiv- (not est-). Completed past -- describes a temporary state at one specific past moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -ar imperfect: estava, estavas, estava... Imperfect past -- describes an ongoing temporary state.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: tiv- (not tenh- or the regular te- form). Completed past -- had something at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Irregular stem: tin- (not te-). Imperfect past -- 'used to have' or 'had been having' over time.

tenseNotes.preterite: Completely suppletive stem, identical to ser: fui, foste, foi, fomos, foram. Completed past -- went somewhere on one occasion.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -ir imperfect: ia, ias, ia, íamos, iam, iam. Imperfect past -- 'used to go' or 'was going' repeatedly.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: fiz-/fez (not faz-). Completed past -- did or made something at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -er imperfect: fazia, fazias, fazia... Imperfect past -- was doing or making something habitually.

subjectHints.eu: First person singular (eu) is 'fiz' -- don't confuse it with 'fez', which is he/she.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: pud- (eu pude, ele pôde) instead of the regular pod- stem. Completed past -- was able to at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -er imperfect: podia, podias, podia... Imperfect past -- was able to habitually.

subjectHints.eu: First person singular (eu) is 'pude' -- don't confuse it with 'pôde', which is he/she.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: quis- (not quer-). In the preterite, querer usually means 'tried' (affirmative) or 'refused' (negative) rather than a plain past 'wanted' -- it marks a one-time attempt, not an ongoing desire. Completed past.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -er imperfect, no stem change: queria, querias, queria... Imperfect past -- an ongoing desire or state, not a single attempt.

subjectHints.eu: First person singular (eu) is 'quis' -- spelled the same as he/she, so context tells them apart.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: diss- (not diz-). Completed past -- said something at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -er imperfect: dizia, dizias, dizia... Imperfect past -- was saying something habitually.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: v- (not ve-). Completed past -- saw something at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -er imperfect: via, vias, via... Imperfect past -- used to see or was seeing repeatedly.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: d-/de- (not the regular da- form). Completed past -- gave something at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -ar imperfect: dava, davas, dava... Imperfect past -- used to give habitually.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem across forms: veio-, vier-, vim- (not the regular vi- form). Completed past -- came at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Irregular stem: vinha- (not vi-). Imperfect past -- 'used to come' or 'was coming' repeatedly.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: soub- (not sab-). Completed past -- found out or learned something at one specific moment ('came to know').
tenseNotes.imperfect: Regular -er imperfect: sabia, sabias, sabia... Imperfect past -- used to know or was knowing something over time.

subjectHints.eu: First person singular (eu) is 'soube' -- spelled the same as he/she, so context tells them apart.

tenseNotes.preterite: Irregular stem: pus-/pôs (not the regular po- form). Completed past -- put something at one specific moment.
tenseNotes.imperfect: Irregular stem: punha- (not the regular po- form). Imperfect past -- 'used to put' or 'was putting' repeatedly.

subjectHints.eu: First person singular (eu) is 'pus' -- don't confuse it with 'pôs', which is he/she.
